limits: Only bounded stream continuity and same-boot counters; no rendered animation or calibrated force/direction acceptance.
HTTP snapshots and observer clocks are not frame-level acquisition timestamps or latency/jitter measurements.
No reset/zero/tare or sensor commands; held state is operator description, not independently measured constant force.

initial_inference: Teensy main-loop/timer and PC read loop progress, but Teensy consumed UART bytes and packet/USB attempts do not progress in this window. Fault is upstream of PC frame parsing in observed stream; does not identify CoinFT TX, wiring, level shifting or Teensy UART RX root cause. Source inspection confirms consumed-byte counts only advance when available()>25 allows reading; this is not a physical wire arrival counter and does not exclude up to25 residual bytes. Same servicePID41924 and USB identity/status observed after capture.
causality_limit: Last valid PC frame predates first snapshot by roughly five minutes; present minus-X action cannot be established as the onset trigger.
